newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Citibank Int'l gets HK banking licence.
newsitem.headline: Citibank Int'l gets HK banking licence.

text.p: Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Wednesday it had granted a restricted banking licence to Citibank International, a wholly-owned unit of Citibank N.A.
The new branch of Citibank International in Hong Kong would take over the existing credit card business of Citibank's existing Hong Kong branch, it said in a statement.
After granting the restricted banking licence to Citibank International, the number of restricted licence banks in Hong Kong has increased to 63.

Miami-based Citibank International has branches in Honolulu, Houston, Los Angeles and San Francisco. Its business includes the provision of foreign trade finance to U.S. residents and acceptance of deposits from non-U.S. residents, the HKMA said.
Citibank is the banking arm of Citicorp.
